Simple but effective little buttons. My tobacco stays as moist as when it was first purchased. The only issue is that they can come apart, other than this they do what they are advertised to do.

reviews.t: Works great on old and new pipe tobacco
reviews.x: These work great. About the size of a quarter and last at least a week on each fill of water. I soak them for 30 min in a cup of distilled water and it keeps my pipe tobacco perfectly moist in the pouches up to 2 weeks on each soak. I added them to 3 year old tobacco that I never humidified which had dried hard like sawdust and the buttons moistened my tobacco back to like new and fresh. It was good to smoke too! Love these things and a must for tobaccoists.
Really, Really, refreshes your smoke. Only leave in, for a few hours at a time. Overnight at an extreme. Or... it'll be too moist, to crumble then smoke.
I still don't fully understand what they do except for the fact that.  It keeps the tabaco moist so for that it does a good job.
keeps my tobacco moist, but seems to require wetting more than ones i've used before
Items appear to be good quality and arrived undamaged and quickly.
These work great for keeping your pipe weed from drying out.
Items keep pipe tobacco fresh!  Work great.

reviews.t: Don't get tongue bite! Keep pipe tobacco fresh or rejuvenate a dried out tin. Doesn't prevent cancer.
reviews.x: These preserve the freshness of pipe tobacco after you open the tin and before it gets all dried out. But, if you smoke like a chimney, you probably finish a tin of tobacco way before it goes stale. I tend to smoke my pipe more in the winter months, so I have unfinished tins of tobacco laying around getting dried out. Just soak one of these buttons in water for a moment and then place it in the tin with the tobacco. In a day or two, your dried out tobacco is good as new! And just as bad for you

this works great! I I got a few of these and they work very well and pretty quickly. I just let a few drops of water absorb into the button then I put it in jar with my herbal medicine and when I came back in the morning the herbs were fresh and easier to smoke (harder to grind though).

These little moisture buttons work like a charm for what I use them for. Being that they're small I use them in my travel cigar case which holds 10 sticks nicely. I personally think they're a little too small to use in a humidor alone & I don't intend on experimenting with my cigars.

reviews.t: fast shipping out of Vermont. I dismantle and smoke ...
reviews.x: fast shipping out of Vermont. I dismantle and smoke my butts so my tobacco mix can get kind of dry. Two of these soaked 10 min will keep a 6 oz can of bugler dry for a day. Then resoak for 10 min. Not sure how long they last. I guess I'll know when my stash gets dry.

well i cant say enough about how well these work. i thought id seen it all then i saw these. well for the price i figured whats to lose? SUPER HAPPY i took a chance on these. if you wanna keep your stuff moist n tasty not dry n harsh this is the best thing out there.

Ok, i understand the concept but i'm having a hard time making them work... it has nothing to do with the quality but the access to water when i needed to refill them.. but since i'm new at this pipe smoking buisness i'm sure i'll figure it out..thanks

reviews.t: Great for dry tobacco like American Spirit
reviews.x: I love my American Spirit tobacco but it can dry out pretty quickly after opening the package. These little things are great and don't leave any residual taste like you would get by putting a small piece of lemon peel in the pouch.

reviews.t: but they're cheap and they get the job done just fine.
reviews.x: I was a little nervous after seeing some of the reviews about how cheap these are, but I've had no problems with them. They probably won't last a hundred years, but they're cheap and they get the job done just fine.

These little buttons are great. Only had in my tobacco for a few hours. My tobacco taste much better. Even put one in my already rolled cig tin. I tried a humidity pouch, but didn't really work. Love these buttons!

reviews.t: best investment for the tobacco enthusiasts
reviews.x: I was amazed at the speed at which I received this and it works wonders for my pipe tobacco my initial order was not enough so I got 10 more of these handy humidifiers have never had to deal with dry tobacco since

I had ordered some pipe tobacco. When it arrived it was quite dry. I put the tobacco in a sealed container along with 2 moisture pouch buttons. In a couple of days the tobacco was moist and aromatic again.

I recieved these and although they are small they work very well in my cotainer and keep my tobacco nice and moist. You do have to resoak them every few days but thats the same wit any humidifier you use;
I have bought these, but not from this website. Apparently they're $5.90 for 5? Look around, maybe at a smoking pipes dot com website, and they're $.80 apiece. Better deal, and they work very well.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the buttons effectively keep pipe tobacco, herbs, and other smokeables moist and fresh.
Several reviewers note the buttons work quickly and can even rejuvenate old or dried-out tobacco.
A few reviewers mention the buttons require re-soaking fairly often or more often than expected.
Some reviewers note a lack of instructions or uncertainty about soak time and lifespan.
A couple of reviewers mention the buttons can come apart or are too small for larger uses like a humidor.
